shared_tail.surface: أبا إبراهيم موسى بن جعفر بن محمد

notes: the leading «19 -» is a number, not a name; «قال: وحدثنا» starts a second isnad right after the first, so a second group; the two routes meet at Ahmad b. Hilal and the text writes Umayya and Ziyad once after them (rule 3)
«سمعت أبا إبراهيم موسى بن جعفر بن محمد يقول» names the Imam only in the words after the chain: last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
